{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I put Shysa out of his misery. We were surrounded, he was too badly hurt to escape, and I couldn't leave him to the Sevvets.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Goran Beviin]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sevvets''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group that attempted to capture [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Fenn Shysa]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on [[Shogun (planet)|Shogun]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Sevvets were able to critically wound Shysa, who ordered Fett to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Gender/Legends|him]] and take his place as ''Mand'alor''.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|141|Sevvets}}</ref>
